paper.title: Distributed Clustering of Linear Bandits in Peer to Peer Networks

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-Agent Linear Bandits (gossip sharing in a peer to peer network)
unmapped: Communication restricted to a gossip protocol: each agent shares information with one random peer per round
Regret summed over all |V| agents, all solving the same linear bandit
settings.definition_quote: a set of actions (equivalently, the contexts) arrives for each agent i, D_t^i \subset D and we assume the set D is a subset of the unit ball in R^d; each agent, i, chooses an action (context) x_t^i \in D_t^i, and receives a reward r_t^i = (x_t^i)^T \theta + \xi_t^i, where \theta is some unknown coefficient vector, and \xi_t^i is some zero mean, R-subGaussian noise; last, the agents can share information according to some protocol across a communication channel.

unmapped: Agents partitioned into unknown clusters U^k, each with its own unknown parameter theta^k
Gossip communication: one random peer per round
Context vectors i.i.d. with E[x x^T] having minimal eigenvalue lambda > 0 (Assumption A); lambda is an algorithm input
settings.definition_quote: let {U^k}_{k = 1,...,M} be a clustering of V, assume some coefficient vector theta^k for each k, and let for agent i in U^k the reward of action x_t^i be given by r_t^i = (x_t^i)^T theta^k + xi_t^i. ... (A) Each context set D^i_t = {x_k}_k is finite and contains i.i.d. random vectors such that for all, k, ||x_k|| <= 1 and E(x_k x_k^T) is full rank, with minimal eigenvalue lambda>0.

symbols.sigma: sub-Gaussian parameter R of the noise

conditions: action sets inside the unit ball of R^d
tuning: tau(t) = 4 log(|V|^{3/2} t) delay (as stated in theorem)

source.label: thm:Main
source.quote: Let $\tau(\cdot):t\rightarrow 4\log(|V|^{\frac{3}{2}}t)$. Then, with probability $1-\delta$, the regret of DCB is bounded by \cR_t \le (N(\delta)|V| + \nu(|V|,d,t))\|\theta\|_2 + 4e^2 (\beta(t) + 4R) \sqrt{|V|t \ln((1+|V|t/d)^d)}, where \nu(|V|,d,t):=(d+1)d^2 (4|V|\ln(|V|^{3/2}t))^3, N(\delta):= \sqrt{3}/((1 - 2^{-1/4})\sqrt{\delta}), and \beta(t):=R \sqrt{\ln ((1 + |V|t/d)^d/\delta)} + \| \theta\|_2.

results.notes: Regret defined via expected rewards per round, summed over agents; holds w.p. 1-delta. Theorem states tau(t)=4log(|V|^{3/2}t) whereas the pseudocode uses t - 4log2(|V|^{3/2} t) (the delay). Anytime: no horizon needed.

conditions: action sets inside the unit ball of R^d

source.quote: We can recover a bound in expectation from Theorem \ref{thm:Main}, by using the value $\delta = 1/\sqrt{|V|t}$: \bE[\cR_t] \le O( t^{1/4}) + \sqrt{|V|t}\|\theta\|_2 + 4e^2( R\sqrt{\ln ((1 + |V|t/d)^d\sqrt{|V|t})} + \| \theta\|_2 + 4R)\sqrt{|V|t \ln((1+|V|t/d)^d)}.

results.notes: Statement mixes an O(t^{1/4}) term with explicit terms; recorded whole expression under O notation. delta depends on t, so treated as known horizon.

symbols.C_clust: constant C(gamma,|V|,lambda,delta): time until true clustering is identified
symbols.gamma: smallest distance between cluster parameters theta^k

conditions: Assumption (A): context sets finite, i.i.d. vectors with ||x||<=1 and E[x x^T] full rank with minimal eigenvalue lambda>0
regret is the total cumulative regret of cluster k
tuning: threshold c_lambda^thresh(t) as in Gentile et al. 2014

source.label: thm:DCCB_main
source.quote: Assume that (A) holds, and let $\gamma$ denote the smallest distance between the bandit parameters $\theta^k$. Then there exists a constant $C = C(\gamma,|V|,\lambda,\delta)$, such that with probability $1-\delta$ the total cumulative regret of cluster $k$ when the agents employ DCCB is bounded by \cR_t \le [\max\{\sqrt{2}N(\delta), C + 4\log_2 (|V|^{3/2}C)\}|U^k| +\nu(|U^k|,d,t) ] \|\theta\|_2 + 4e(\beta(t) + 3R)\sqrt{ |U^k|t \ln((1+|U^k| t/d)^d)}, where N and \nu are as defined in Theorem 1, and \beta(t) := R\sqrt{2\ln((1+|U^k| t/d)^d)} + \|\theta\|_2.

results.notes: nu(|U^k|,d,t) interpreted by substituting |U^k| for |V| in nu. C is not explicit. beta here contains no delta term as written in the theorem.
